design: 16 sites (8 archived + 8 new, all-distinct tiles) x arms A (field only) / B (field + p1218_conf_v2_amp4.zarr) / C (random placebo) x 5 fresh reps per arm; unit = run; paired t across sites of replicate means, df=15

arms.C: sites 0-7: p1218_conf_rand_amp4.zarr (rng 20260806); sites 8-15: p1218_conf_rand_amp4_ext8.zarr (rng 20260812); both region-scoped random redraws, radius 288 L1, amp_scale 4, matched count/sigma/amp/support

new_site_selection.rule: select_sites16.py, deterministic, no RNG: candidate pool and thresholds identical to demo_sites.py (census8k clusters, ratio >= 3.0, n_sites >= 2, tile-interior margin 48, sort by (-n_sites, -ratio)); constraints: exclude the 7 tiles used by the original 8 sites, at most one new site per tile, slab cap 2 across old+new, m7 L1 seed value >= 128 (feasibility); pass 1 picks top 8 among mid-scroll band candidates (0.25*zmax < gz < 0.8*zmax, zmax=11405), top-up pass unused (8/8 filled in pass 1); 0 candidates skipped for m7 < 128
